name: What are the limitations of using AI for property valuation?

mainEntity.name: What are the limitations of using AI for property valuation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The limitations of AI property valuation include its reliance on available data, meaning it might not fully account for unrecorded renovations, unique property conditions, or highly localized market anomalies. It also lacks the human judgment to assess subjective factors like curb appeal or the impact of very specific neighborhood nuisances. For properties in areas with less data or highly custom homes, the estimates may have a wider variance. This highlights a practical tradeoff between speed and nuanced accuracy.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI valuations rely on data and may miss unrecorded renovations or subjective factors; they lack human judgment for unique property conditions.
